name: GPU Starvation
symptom: Long request latency with gaps between short GPU bursts.
alternatives: Input supply, CPU preprocessing, synchronization or storage.
evidence: Compare input-ready times and device work; remove only the input delay.
repair: Prefetch or batch the measured bottleneck with bounded buffers.
regression: Same records and outputs; repeated steady-state timings improve.
boundary: Low utilization alone does not identify a cause.

name: Recompilation Storm
symptom: Repeated capture or compile costs as metadata changes.
alternatives: Guard failures, graph breaks or normal warmup.
evidence: Match shapes and failed guards; compare capture counts.
repair: Use supported dynamic dimensions or justified shape buckets.
regression: Outputs agree and representative shapes avoid excess captures.
boundary: A graph count is not a kernel count or a performance result.

name: Retained Tensor
symptom: Live allocation grows during fixed-size repeated work.
alternatives: References, intentional cache or changing input shapes.
evidence: Clear the suspected owner and compare live bytes.
repair: Release unnecessary owners and bound intentional caches.
regression: Repeated fixed workload returns live bytes to baseline.
boundary: Reserved memory alone does not establish retention.

name: Silent Numerical Divergence
symptom: Successful execution violates an intermediate tolerance.
alternatives: Masking, preprocessing, dtype, reduction or implementation defect.
evidence: Find the earliest mismatch with identical inputs and weights.
repair: Repair the first violated contract and declare tolerances.
regression: Padding, near-zero and nonfinite cases are covered.
boundary: Top-ranked agreement can conceal damaged representations.

name: Retrieval Drift
symptom: Retrieval quality changes while execution succeeds.
alternatives: Corpus, embedding, index, normalization or metric changes.
evidence: Use fixed judged queries and substitute trusted context.
repair: Version components together and rebuild mismatched indexes.
regression: Held-out retrieval and answer metrics meet the acceptance contract.
boundary: The deterministic fixture does not measure real-world drift.

name: Missing Trace
symptom: Completed request lacks expected observable phases.
alternatives: Sampling, export loss, lost context or absent instrumentation.
evidence: Compare phase expectations, span identities and correlated logs.
repair: Repair export or context propagation and retain missing-data status.
regression: Healthy control passes; forced removal is detected.
boundary: Unknown events cannot be recovered from silence.

name: Allocation Pressure
symptom: Failure grows with context or concurrent requests.
alternatives: Weights, KV cache, activations, other processes or allocator state.
evidence: Reduce one dimension and retain framework, guest and device scope.
repair: Bound context and concurrency or use supported explicit offload.
regression: Previously failing bounded workload succeeds with measured headroom.
boundary: 64GB system and 30GB GPU reports are not additive pools.

name: Kernel Contract Violation
symptom: Wrong output, illegal access or sanitizer error.
alternatives: Indexing, alignment, bounds, race or launch configuration.
evidence: Small CPU oracle, odd dimensions and the relevant sanitizer.
repair: Repair the indexing or synchronization contract.
regression: Edge cases and sanitizer checks pass before timing.
boundary: One clean case does not prove correctness for all inputs.

name: Host Progress Stall
symptom: Last completed stage stays fixed while a response is absent.
alternatives: Event wait, I/O, deadlock, worker exit or device wait.
evidence: Bounded deadline plus host stacks and progress records.
repair: Repair signaling or ownership and provide a bounded recovery path.
regression: Completion and cancellation paths behave as specified.
boundary: A host stack does not expose device program counters.

name: Bandwidth Ceiling
symptom: Performance tracks data movement more than useful arithmetic.
alternatives: Memory traffic, cache effects, launch cost or limited parallelism.
evidence: Use measured traffic at a named level and the matching roofline.
repair: Reduce confirmed traffic or improve reuse.
regression: Outputs remain correct and unprofiled timing improves.
boundary: Analytic bytes are not measured DRAM bytes.

name: Measurement Corruption
symptom: Graphs contradict raw records or request counts.
alternatives: Duplicates, stale samples, units, timestamps or aggregation.
evidence: Validate identity, scope, metadata and independent counts.
repair: Repair acquisition or transformation and preserve originals.
regression: Malformed fixtures fail while valid records pass.
boundary: Flat values alone do not prove staleness.

name: Quality Boundary Failure
symptom: Valid execution produces an unacceptable answer.
alternatives: Retrieval, assembly, truncation, generation or validation.
evidence: Restore one boundary with known-good data.
repair: Repair the responsible boundary and retain adverse examples.
regression: Independent correctness and acceptance checks pass.
boundary: Multiple simultaneous defects may defeat single substitutions.
